description: List the play tabs of a game that a member of the workspace has open right now (heartbeat within 30 s; closed tabs are gone): session id, last seen, viewer role, engine, backend (webgpu/webgl2) and render thread (worker/main). The first is the default target of gripforge_debug_snapshot / gripforge_debug_set. Empty: no tab is open, and the debug tools answer at once that no game tab is open. 0 credits.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_debug_sessions
title: Live game tabs for the debug inspector
